Subject: Follow-up: Draft MAP + next steps (post-demo recap)

Hi Jane / Tom — great to meet you both on the demo today. Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx) that captures the milestones we discussed. High level recap below and proposed owners/dates: 

- Milestone 1: Tech evaluation complete — Owner: Acme (Tom) — Target: 2026-07-08
- Milestone 2: Security review + evidence handoff — Owner: Acme Security (security@acme.com) — Target: 2026-07-10
- Milestone 3: Pilot configuration & integration (staging) — Owner: Redwood (Camila) — Target: 2026-07-14
- Milestone 4: Pilot acceptance (success criteria below) — Owner: Acme PM (Jane) — Target: 2026-07-18
- Milestone 5: Go-live / Production cutover — Owner: Joint — Target: 2026-07-20

Success criteria (we agreed): 1) 99th percentile latency < 400ms on representative traffic; 2) <5% failed requests under peak; 3) qualitative acceptance from Acme search team after 3 day validation window.

Dependencies: security questionnaire completion, access to a test S3 bucket, decision on model variant (we recommended r-instruct-3b-quant).

Next steps: 
- Jane / Tom: confirm owners + any date adjustments by EOD Friday (2026-07-03).
- Camila / Ben: we will prepare SOW draft and DocuSign envelope after you confirm MAP.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated file after your notes.

--
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick notes from our side after reviewing with the PM and security: 

- We can own Milestone 1 (tech evaluation) and Milestone 4 (pilot acceptance). Target dates look OK but would like to move Milestone 2 (security review) to 2026-07-12 to give security time to run through the SOC2 artifacts.
- Security will need the SOC2 report and a small subset of audit logs (redacted) — can you confirm what Redwood can provide and timing?
- On success criteria, the product team would like an additional acceptance item: ability to route fallback to the smaller model under load with no functional regression. Is that something we can include?

If you can confirm the security deliverables and adjust Milestone 2 to 7/12, we’ll lock these dates and flag for our procurement to start the SOW review.
